changes.title: Celine Dion returns to the stage after battling rare illness
changes.summary: The Canadian singer opened up her 16-show residency in Paris at the Plenitude Arena. The entire series is sold out. (Image credit: Aurelien Morissard).

changes.title: Celine Dion overcomes rare neurological disorder to perform first concert in 6 years
changes.summary: Celine Dion's return to the stage underscored a remarkable comeback after stiff-person syndrome, an incurable condition that causes stiffness and cramps, forced her to cancel shows and cast years of uncertainty over whether she would ever perform again.
